title: Dry Hop Pressure Spike
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kegerator:pressure event=dry_hop
| stats max(psi) as max_psi by batch_name
| where max_psi>15
| sort - max_psi
description: Uses Keg pressure readings telemetry to monitor pressure spikes after dry-hop additions in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for batches that need extra venting attention, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Keg pressure readings data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Batch table of maximum pressure during dry hopping.
grandmaExplanation: It totals pressure spikes after dry-hop additions so you can spot batches that need extra venting attention before it becomes annoying.
